name: Ferienwohnungen Kröll Alois
beschreibung:
Centrally yet quietly situated in renowned Mayrhofen, the Kroell family welcomes visitors with authentic Tyrolean hospitality. Well-tended apartments feature ample living space, modern kitchens, and balconies facing the Zillertal Alps.

The base stations of the Penkenbahn and Ahornbahn cable cars, shops, restaurants, and hiking trails are all within a short walk.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnungen Kroell Alois in Mayrhofen offers cosy holiday living in the heart of the Zillertal valley.
